annotations.title: Find or create the app's calendar

description: Find, or create the first time, the calendar TaskLite keeps in the user's Google account under a name (default "פגישות"). It appears in their Google Calendar beside their own calendars, with its own colour, on every device. Returns { calendarId, created }. The event tools find it by name themselves; call this to know the id or to create it ahead.

description.description: Shown in Google Calendar under the name

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

timeZone.description: IANA timezone the dates and times are in, default "Asia/Jerusalem"

name: google_calendar_ensure_calendar
